info.title: Get Payments
info.description:
**This API is currently unavailable to SEA markets.**
Retrieves records of automated payments for a shop based on a specified date range.
Use the returned list to verify and reconcile payments with the transactions in the seller's bank account.

get.description:
**This API is currently unavailable to SEA markets.**
Retrieves records of automated payments for a shop based on a specified date range.
Use the returned list to verify and reconcile payments with the transactions in the seller's bank account.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: create_time_lt
parameters.description:
Filter payments to show only those that occurred before the specified date and time. Unix timestamp.
Refer to notes in `create_time_ge` for more usage information.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
The number of results to be returned per page. 
Default: 20
Valid range: [1-100]

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Retrieve this value from the result of the `next_page_token` from a previous response. It is not needed for the first page.

parameters.name: sort_field
parameters.description: The returned results will be sorted by the specified field. Only supports `create_time`.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description:
The sort order for the `sort_field` parameter. 
Default: ASC 
Possible values:
- ASC: Ascending order
- DESC: Descending order

parameters.name: create_time_ge
parameters.description:
Filter payments to show only those that occurred on or after the specified date and time. Unix timestamp.

**Note:**
`create_time_ge` and `create_time_lt` together constitute the creation time filter condition.
- If `create_time_ge` is filled but `create_time_lt` is empty, `create_time_lt` will default to the current time.
- If `create_time_lt` is filled but `create_time_ge` is empty, `create_time_ge` will default to the earliest shop time.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

next_page_token.description: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Provide this value in the `page_token` parameter of your request if the current response does not return all the results.

create_time.description: The time when the payment was initiated in TikTok Shop. Unix timestamp.

status.description:
The payment status, indicating whether payment has been transferred to the seller's bank account.
Possible values:
- PAID: Payment has been transferred to the seller.
- FAILED: Payment transfer failed.
- PROCESSING: Payment is currently being processed.

currency.description: The exchange currency code in ISO 4217 format.

amount.description: The final payment amount after currency exchange.

currency.description: The original currency code in ISO 4217 format.

settlement_amount.description: The settlement amount before currency exchange.

currency.description: The original currency code in ISO 4217 format.

payment_amount_before_exchange.description: The original payment amount before currency exchange.

exchange_rate.description: The exchange rate, displayed with six decimal places.

paid_time.description: The time when the payment was successfully processed. Unix timestamp.

bank_account.description: The seller's bank account number masked, revealing only the last 4 digits for privacy.

payments.description: The list of payments that meet the query conditions.
